The user wants app UI strings in Traditional Chinese (Taiwan usage).

Screen: mobile app list page, pull down to refresh (fetch latest data from backend).

- s1: hint text when pulling down (下拉時的提示文字)
- s2: status text after fetching completes (取完後的狀態文字)
- s3: text when list is empty (清單為空時的文字)

Taiwan terminology: avoid 刷新, use 重新整理.

So:
- s1: "下拉即可重新整理" or "下拉重新整理" — pull down hint. Common in Taiwan apps: "下拉以更新" or "下拉即可更新資料". Given the constraint table says use 重新整理 instead of 刷新. So s1: "下拉即可重新整理" or "下拉重新整理".

- s2: after fetching done: "已更新" or "已重新整理" — status text. "已重新整理" fits.

- s3: empty list: "目前沒有任何項目" or "尚無資料" — Taiwan usage: "尚無資料" or "沒有資料". Common: "查無資料" (used in Taiwan government sites), "尚無資料". For a list empty state: "目前沒有資料" or "尚無任何項目". I'll use "尚無資料" or maybe "目前沒有任何項目".

Let me pick:
- s1: "下拉即可重新整理"
- s2: "已重新整理"
- s3: "尚無資料"

Output only JSON object with keys s1, s2, s3.</think>{
  "s1": "下拉即可重新整理",
  "s2": "已重新整理",
  "s3": "尚無資料"
}
